base_style: Brutalist comic strip in thick, shaking hand-drawn charcoal lines on yellowed heavy-grain parchment, with heavy charcoal vignetting and lens damage (vertical scratches, grease, dried splatter).
characters: Sweat-slicked, tense, expressive figures versus mechanical, vacant-eyed doppelgangers. Varying detail dissolves into dark muddy silhouettes in wide/chaotic shots. Sickly mustard highlights and deep bruised-purple shadows.
color_palette: 'The Bruise & The Bile': sickly mustard yellows, deep bruised purples, dried-scab reds, sickly green glows, heavy bubbling charcoal blacks on yellowed parchment under smog-choked grey light.
layout_and_composition: 5-panel strip with uneven hand-carved charcoal borders. High-tension cinematic cameras (shaky action, extreme close-ups, long-shot silhouettes) obscured by smog, lens grease, and splatter.
lettering_and_dialog: Dialogue in hand-torn graying vellum strips with cramped, ink-blotted, shaky or precise calligraphy matching emotion. SFX as large jagged charcoal letters scratched into the artwork.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: Hand-torn graying vellum, cramped ink-blotted calligraphy (shaky/precise by tone). Captions/Voice Over/Chyrons: N/A. Sound Effects: Raw jagged charcoal scratched into surfaces (e.g., CREEEEEEAK..., SKREEEEEEEEEE!, THWIP—SQUELCH!).
environmental_atmosphere: Thick physical atmosphere of palpable smog, stagnant green-filmed water, and cinematic lens degradation (grease, dried splatter, heavy charcoal vignetting).
sound_effects_integration: Sound effects carved and scratched directly into background geometry and structures, never floating as isolated graphics.
shadow_behavior: Shadows as active actors—deep bruised purples that stretch and reach across panels to heighten tension.
silhouette_rendering: High-chaos or wide shots collapse character detail into thick, bubbling-black muddy charcoal silhouettes emphasizing scale and density.
